chapter.heading: Thanksgiving for Deliverance from Death
chapter.v:
I love
the Lord, because He has heardMy voice and my supplications.

Because He
has inclined His ear to me,Therefore I will call upon Him as long as I live. [Ezek. 16:8; Hos. 2:15 b Deut. 2:7; Jer. 2:6]

The pains
of death surrounded me,And the pangs of Sheol laid hold of me;I found trouble and sorrow. [[Ex. 19:5, 6; Deut. 7:6; 14:2]] [Gen. 12:3; Is. 41:11; Jer. 30:15,] [James 1:18; Rev. 14:4 e Jer. 12:14]

Then I
called upon the name of the Lord:“O Lord, I implore You, deliver my soul!”

Gracious is
the Lord, and righteous;Yes, our God is merciful. [Is. 5:4; Mic. 6:3 h 2 Kin. 17:15; Jer. 8:19; [Jon. 2:8]; Rom. 1:21]

The Lord
preserves the simple;I was brought low, and He saved me. [Ex. 20:2; Is. 63:11 j Deut. 8:15;]

Return to
your rest, O my soul,For the Lord has dealt bountifully with you. [Num. 35:33; Is. 24:5; Hos. 4:3] [Num. 13:27 one among many; He alone is God of Israel (see Deut. 6:4). your robe in your belt so you can run (see]

For You
have delivered my soul from death,My eyes from tears,And my feet from falling. [Rom. 2:20] [Jer. 23:13]

I will
walk before the LordIn the land of the living. [Jer. 2:35; Ezek. 20:35, 36; Mic. 6:2]

I believed,
therefore I spoke,“I am greatly afflicted.” [Jer. 18:13]

I said
in my haste,“All men are liars.” [Mic. 4:5 r Ps. 115:4; Is. 37:19] [Ps. 106:20; Rom.]

What shall
I render to the LordFor all His benefits toward me?

I will
take up the cup of salvation,And call upon the name of the Lord. [Ps. 36:9; Jer. 17:13; [John 4:14]]

I will
pay my vows to the LordNow in the presence of all His people. [[Ex. 4:22]]

Precious in
the sight of the LordIs the death of His saints. [Is. 1:7; Jer.]

O Lord,
truly I am Your servant;I am Your servant, the son of Your maidservant;You have loosed my bonds. [2 Kin. 23:29- 37; Jer. 43:7-9]

I will
offer to You the sacrifice of thanksgiving,And will call upon the name of the Lord. [Jer. 4:18] [Deut. 32:10]

I will
pay my vows to the LordNow in the presence of all His people, [Josh. 13:3] [Is. 30:1-3] [Hos. 5:13 8 The]

In the
courts of the Lord’s house,In the midst of you, O Jerusalem.Praise the Lord! [Is. 3:9; Jer. 4:18; Hos. 5:5]
